---
description: "Use when planning, updating, or reviewing non-trivial work so live execution stays in dedicated task files instead of broad docs."
applyTo: ".ai/tasks/**/*.md"
---

# Dedicated Task Files

- Use one task file per coherent outcome.
- Keep broad expert and reference docs stable.
- Non-trivial task files must contain an `Intent Contract` section.
- Put live execution state, phased TODOs, blockers, evidence, and open questions in task files.
- Minimum sections:
  - `Context`
  - `Intent Contract`
  - `In Progress`
  - `TODO`
  - `Dependency`
  - `Open Questions`
  - `Done`
- When the task is resolved, move durable conclusions back into the relevant expert, reference, or memory file.
